pages.text: Pound Cake can be made by compacting "1 pound" of Eggs, Dough, Sugar, Cream, and Almond Extract. This cake can be cut by a saw into 7 slices.$(br)Quick sidenote, the measurements are probably not exact, so don't take the recipe too seriously.
The Glass of Royal Cider item can be placed down as a decorative item while sneaking. While it just be instantly broken, you can also shift+right-click to pick it back up.
Gumdrops can be placed on the ground in groups of up to 4 to be a decorative, festive treat.
All variants of gingerbread cookies can be placed and stacked up to 6 times to decorate your festivities space.
